{{Quote|We lost another crew to trilom poisoning. It's not like we haven't enough to worry about, but now we have our friends to deal with.|Chief [[Armstrong]]|<ref name="SWG:MM" />}}
The '''Poisoned Miner's Camp''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] camp in the [[Crystal Flats/Legends|Crystal Flats]] region of the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. A [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] mining crew used it as their base camp for their mining operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:MM" />

==History==
{{Quote|One of our field crews hit a patch of trilom gas while they were sampling. They didn't have the proper gear and now...never mind.|Chief Armstrong|<ref name="SWG:MM" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the miners at this camp hit a pocket of [[trilom]] gas and were [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by it. Trilom gas caused paranoia, [[dementia]], eventually an agonizing [[Death/Legends|death]] and there was no remedy. When Chief [[Armstrong]] learned of the fate of his mining crew, he asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to venture to the mining camp and put the miners out of their misery. The spacer used the camp's [[Targeting computer|tracking computer]] to find the miners that were equipped with [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacons]].<ref name="SWG:MM" />

Later, a spacer visited the camp and collected a [[Mustafar bandit sword|HK-47 sword]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMIV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Poisoned Miner's Camp was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Poisoned Miner's Camp was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]]. During the quest "[[:w:c:swg:Miner Madness|Miner Madness]]," Chief Armstrong asked the player to travel to this camp and use the tracking computer to track down the trilom infected miners to kill them.<ref name="SWG:MM" />
